message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for the case.

Facts: In Shiyan city, a person Li Moujia (defendant) from Feb 8 to Mar 19 2015, due to dispute among shareholders of a business hotel, repeatedly went to the hotel on several dates and smashed/damaged hotel items, causing damage valued at 3166 RMB.

This is property damage, i.e., "故意毁坏财物罪" (intentional destruction of property). Under Chinese Criminal Law, article 275 (or 275?) Actually article 275 is "故意毁坏财物罪". The value is relatively low (under 2000? Actually 3166 RMB > 2000, but still maybe considered minor. But still criminal.

Thus charge: 故意毁坏财物罪.

Potential also "寻衅滋事罪"? But the act is property damage, not public order. The typical charge is "故意毁坏财物罪". Could also be "破坏公共设施罪"? No, it's private property.

Thus single charge.
